snippet.title: Asterium Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Asterium! 

Watch the first official trailer for Asterium, a multiplayer sci-fi strategy sandbox game where you explore the galaxy, fulfill quests, administer stellar empires and combat in dynamic campaigns.

Key Features:

Cinematic Battles
Watch massive conflicts unfold through dynamic, physics-driven combat. Battles combine large-scale simulation with spectacular emergent moments.

Fully Moddable
Shape Asterium into your own universe. Extend, customize, and transform the sandbox with mods built for experimentation and community creativity.

Classic Tile-Based Planets
Inspired by classic 4X planet management, every world is a strategic puzzle. Develop tiles, balance resources, and turn each planet into a unique part of your empire.


Follow the development of Asterium and join our community:
🌐 Website: https://hammerborne.com/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/CyMMWXR5QN

🔔 Don't forget to subscribe to the channel and hit the notification bell so you don't miss future updates and the release date!
